tools.name: powerbi_manage_relationship
tools.title: Manage Table Relationship
tools.description: Creates, updates, or deletes a relationship between two tables in the Power BI model. Action can be 'create', 'delete', or 'set_active'. Requires 'Allow Model Modifications / DAX Execution' checked on the Bridge UI.

isActive.description: Whether the relationship is active (default true).

tools.name: execute_powerbi_code
tools.title: Execute C# in Power BI
tools.description: Runs a C# script against the Power BI Desktop tabular model via AMO-TOM (Microsoft.AnalysisServices.Tabular). Globals: model (active TOM Model), server (TOM Server connected to local Analysis Services), adomd (active AdomdConnection for DAX execution), ct, log(string), progress(cur,total,msg), args (args.Str/Int/Double/Bool(key, fallback)). Return value: End with `return <value>;`. Mutation safety: Writing operations that call model.SaveChanges() require 'Allow Model Mutation' ticked on the Bridge window, else error -32001. A snapshot backup of model metadata is created before applying mutations. dryRun=true validates script compilation and static structure without committing changes. Timeout: 5–120 seconds (up to 600 seconds when enabled). Forbidden: System.IO, reflection, processes, threads, network, modal dialogs, disposing/disconnecting server or adomd.

code.description: C# script body, max 32 KB. Has access to model, server, adomd.

transaction.description: auto (default): writing script. none: read-only script. manual: accepted for compatibility.

label.description: Short label for audit log and snapshot name.

args.description: Optional JSON object passed to the script as args.

tools.name: powerbi_format_dax
tools.title: Format DAX Expression
tools.description: Formats a DAX expression with proper indentation, keyword capitalization, line breaks, and whitespace.

dax.description: The raw DAX expression to format.

tools.name: get_run
tools.title: Get a past run
tools.description: Details of one run from the history (runId comes back from the execute tool, run_tool and test_tool): outcome, args, the code when it was a successful ad-hoc script, and — when the host application is reachable — an analysis listing hard-coded literals (line, value, variable) and the args keys already read. Use it before propose_tool to decide which literals become parameters.

analyze.description: Analyse the code (guard, compile, literals) through the host application

tools.name: powerbi_evaluate_dax
tools.title: Evaluate DAX Query
tools.description: Executes a DAX query (typically starting with EVALUATE) against the active Power BI Desktop model via ADOMD.NET. Returns tabular results formatted as Markdown table or JSON rows with execution duration and row count. Safely capped by maxRows (default 100, max 10000) to protect context.

query.description: The DAX query to execute (e.g. 'EVALUATE TOPN(10, DimCustomer)' or 'EVALUATE ROW("Revenue", [Total Revenue])').

maxRows.description: Maximum number of rows to return (default 100, max 10000).

format.description: Output format: 'markdown' (default table) or 'json' (array of objects).

tools.name: powerbi_cloud_trigger_refresh
tools.title: Trigger Cloud Dataset Refresh
tools.description: Triggers a data refresh for a dataset / semantic model in Power BI Service.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace ID (GUID). If omitted, assumes 'My workspace'.

tools.name: cancel_execution
tools.title: Cancel running script
tools.description: Signals cancellation to the script currently running in the host application. Cancellation is cooperative: the script stops at its next `ct` check, and its transaction group is rolled back. Returns whether anything was running.

tools.name: run_tool
tools.title: Run a registry tool
tools.description: Run a stored tool from the registry with the given args (must match its inputSchema from search_tools / get_tool). Same result shape as the execute tool. Draft / tested / pending tools need allowUnpublished=true. Use dryRun=true first for tools that modify the document.

allowUnpublished.description: Allow running a tool that is not published yet

tools.name: get_powerbi_context
tools.title: Get Power BI context
tools.description: Returns the Power BI Desktop session the bridge is connected to: hostVersion (2026), docTitle and docPath of the .pbix/.pbip file, isModifiable (connected and model is writable), executionEnabled, and powerBi info {isConnected, attachedPid, localPort, databaseName, compatibilityLevel, mutationEnabled, tableCount, measureCount, relationshipCount}. Fails with 'not connected' if Power BI Desktop is not running or bridge is not connected. Call this before scripting or modifying the model to verify connection and model metadata.

includeSelection.description: Include current selection (reserved for future view selection).

tools.name: powerbi_create_or_update_measure
tools.title: Create or Update DAX Measure
tools.description: Creates a new DAX measure or updates an existing measure in a specified table. Validates DAX syntax, creates a metadata backup snapshot, and calls model.SaveChanges() to persist to Power BI Desktop. Requires 'Allow Model Modifications / DAX Execution' checked on the Bridge UI.

tableName.description: The target table name to place the measure in.

description.description: Optional description / docstring for the measure.

displayFolder.description: Optional display folder path within the table.

tools.name: propose_tool
tools.title: Propose a new registry tool
tools.description: Package a working C# script as a reusable tool (status draft). Replace every literal that may change between calls with args.<Kind>("key") and declare each key in inputSchema (JSON Schema object: string/number/integer/boolean/array/object, required, default, description). The code is guard-checked and compiled inside the host application but not run. Give ≥ 2 examples with different args; test_tool runs them. Returns a validation report; fix errors and call again. Use newVersion=true to replace the code of an existing tool.

description.description: What the tool does, for search and for the reviewer (≥ 20 chars)

category.description: One of the host's categories (search_tools lists them): Architecture | Structure | MEP | Annotation | View | Data | Generic for Revit, Drawing | Layer | Block | Annotation | Layout | Data | Generic for AutoCAD

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema of the args object

code.description: Script body: same globals as the execute tool plus args; must end with return

title.description: Human title, e.g. 'Colour beams by type'

transaction.description: auto (the bridge wraps the run in a transaction) | manual (Revit: the code opens its own Transaction; AutoCAD: same as auto) | none (read-only)

sourceRunId.description: runId of the execute run this comes from (see get_run)

newVersion.description: Propose a new version of an existing tool name

tools.name: publish_tool
tools.title: Publish a registry tool
tools.description: Request publication of a tested tool. Policy manual (default): the tool becomes pending_approval, a review file is written and a human must run the server's `registry approve <name>` command (`<server>.exe registry --help`; or set status=published in tool.json). Policy auto: tested tools publish immediately. Published tools appear in tools/list of every running server.

tools.name: inspect_type
tools.title: Inspect a host API type
tools.description: Reflects over an API type loaded in the running host application (Revit or AutoCAD) and returns its public members as C#-like signatures (kind: property | method | field | event). Use it to confirm exact method names and parameters before writing a script.

typeName.description: Type name, e.g. 'Wall' or 'FilteredElementCollector' in Revit, 'Polyline' or 'LayerTableRecord' in AutoCAD, or a fully qualified name such as 'Autodesk.Revit.DB.Structure.Rebar'.

memberFilter.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to keep only matching member names, e.g. 'Create'.

maxMembers.description: Maximum number of members to return (default 100, max 500).

tools.name: powerbi_cloud_execute_dax
tools.title: Execute DAX on Cloud Dataset
tools.description: Executes a DAX query against a Power BI Service cloud dataset via the Power BI REST API executeQueries endpoint.

query.description: The DAX query to execute (e.g. 'EVALUATE TOPN(5, Sales)').

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace ID (GUID). If omitted, assumes 'My workspace'.

tools.name: powerbi_cloud_list_datasets
tools.title: List Cloud Datasets
tools.description: Lists datasets / semantic models within a specific workspace or 'My workspace'.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace ID (GUID). If omitted, queries 'My workspace'.

tools.name: powerbi_get_schema
tools.title: Get Power BI Model Schema
tools.description: Inspects the Power BI tabular model schema. Returns list of tables, columns (name, dataType, isHidden), measures (name, expression, formatString, displayFolder, description), partitions, and relationships (fromTable/Column -> toTable/Column, cardinality, crossFiltering). Optionally filtered to a specific table.

tableName.description: Optional table name to filter schema for a single table.

includeColumns.description: Whether to include detailed column metadata (default true).

includeRelationships.description: Whether to include table relationships (default true).

tools.name: powerbi_cloud_list_workspaces
tools.title: List Cloud Workspaces
tools.description: Lists Power BI Service / Fabric workspaces accessible by the configured user or Service Principal.

tools.name: test_tool
tools.title: Test a registry tool
tools.description: Run a tool's examples (or the given cases) inside the host application with dryRun — every change is rolled back — and record the outcomes. All cases passing moves a draft to tested. realRun=true commits the changes (only on a scratch model).

cases.description: Optional cases [{"title": "...", "args": {...}}]; default = the tool's examples

tools.name: powerbi_delete_measure
tools.title: Delete DAX Measure
tools.description: Deletes an existing DAX measure from a specified table. Creates a backup snapshot before removing. Requires 'Allow Model Modifications / DAX Execution' checked on the Bridge UI.

tableName.description: The table name containing the measure.

measureName.description: The name of the measure to delete.

tools.name: manage_tool
tools.title: Deprecate, quarantine or restore a tool
tools.description: deprecate: retire a tool (never runs again until restored). quarantine: pull it from tools/list. restore: back to draft so it can be tested and published again.

annotations.title: Deprecate, quarantine or restore a tool

tools.name: get_tool
tools.title: Get a registry tool
tools.description: Full record of one stored tool: metadata, input schema, examples, C# code (optional), run statistics and recent runs.

recentRuns.description: How many recent runs to include (0–50)

tools.name: search_tools
tools.title: Search the tool registry
tools.description: Search the registry of stored tools for this host (Revit or AutoCAD) BEFORE writing code with the execute tool (execute_revit_code / execute_autocad_code). Full-text over name, description, tags and examples, ranked by relevance × stability × status. Returns each tool's inputSchema so it can be called directly by name (published tools are real MCP tools) or through run_tool. Empty query lists tools (optionally by category).

query.description: What you want to do, in any language, e.g. 'tạo lưới trục', 'color beams by type', 'room schedule'

category.description: One of the host's categories (search_tools lists them): Architecture | Structure | MEP | Annotation | View | Data | Generic for Revit, Drawing | Layer | Block | Annotation | Layout | Data | Generic for AutoCAD

includeUnpublished.description: Also return draft / tested / pending tools (they need allowUnpublished=true in run_tool)
